transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well… I don’t want to make too much of it, but I suppose I’m here because of this trouble with our kitchen. It’s been going on nearly two years, and I’m quite sure the contractor and a few people on our block have been sort of… working together, quietly, to cheat us. My husband keeps showing me receipts and they all have excuses, but the kitchen is still half-wrong, and I really do think it’s being kept that way on purpose. I hope that makes sense.
Even when your husband shows you receipts and explanations, are you still certain the contractor and neighbors are deliberately cheating you?

Yes… I know it probably sounds a bit much when I say it plainly, and I’m not trying to be difficult. But yes, even with the receipts my husband shows me, and all the explanations they give, I still feel quite sure this isn’t just mistakes. It’s been nearly two years, and the kitchen is still half-wrong, and I really do think the contractor and some people on the block are quietly keeping it that way to cheat us.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is there?

No… I don’t think so. I mean, I haven’t been hearing voices when nobody’s there, not like that. Sometimes I’ll wonder about things people say or whether I’ve heard something from another room, but not voices speaking to me. Is that the sort of thing you mean?
Have there been times when you felt unusually full of ენერგy and needed much less sleep than usual?

No, I don’t think so. I mean, I have had nights where I don’t sleep well, but not where I’m suddenly full of energy and hardly need sleep. Nothing like that, as far as I’ve noticed. Is that alright—does that answer what you mean?
Have you noticed yourself becoming much less interested in seeing people or doing things you used to enjoy?

Not really, no. I mean, aside from all the stress with the remodel, I do still go to my church gatherings and book club, and I keep up with things around the house and family plans like I usually would. So I wouldn’t say I’ve lost interest in people or things… I hope that makes sense.
Have you been diagnosed with any brain or nervous system illness?

No, not that I know of. I mean, I’ve never been told I have anything like a brain or nerve illness. I’ve had the usual aches and things as I’ve gotten older, but nothing like that… I hope that’s what you’re asking.
Have other people told you that your speech is hard to follow or that your thoughts seem jumbled?

No, I don’t think anyone has said that to me. I mean, sometimes I might go on a bit if I’m trying to explain something, but I haven’t been told my speech is hard to follow or that my thoughts are jumbled. If I’m not answering clearly, you can tell me.
Have you ever felt that someone was putting thoughts into your mind that were not your own?

No… I don’t think anyone is putting thoughts into my mind, not like that. My thoughts feel like my own.

It’s more that I’ve been very sure something is going on with the contractor and a few people on my block, like they’ve been working together quietly to cheat us and keep the kitchen wrong on purpose. I know my husband shows me receipts and they all have their explanations, but it still feels… deliberate. I hope that answers what you mean.
Have you seen things that other people could not see?

No, I don’t believe so. I mean, I wear my glasses and sometimes I might misread something at a distance, but I haven’t seen things that other people couldn’t see. At least, not that I’m aware of. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Has anything happened that seemed impossible in ordinary life, like people controlling events in a way that couldn’t really happen?

I wouldn’t say impossible exactly… I know how that might sound. But I am here because for nearly two years I’ve been sure the contractor and some people on my block have been quietly working together to cheat us and keep my kitchen half-wrong on purpose.

My husband shows me receipts, and they all have explanations, and I try to listen to that. But it still feels like it’s not just mistakes, like it’s being done deliberately. I hope that makes sense.
Have you started using any new medicines or drugs around the time this began?

I don’t think so, no. I mean, I take the usual things, but I can’t think of anything new that started right around then… and I don’t use drugs or anything like that.

If there’s something specific you mean, I can try to remember better. I want to answer it correctly.
Aside from the kitchen situation, do you believe anyone else is trying to harm, cheat, or conspire against you?

No… not really aside from that. I don’t want to make it sound like I think everyone is against me. It’s mainly the contractor, and a few people on the block who I’m pretty sure are involved somehow.

I know my husband says the receipts explain things, and maybe some of it could look like excuses or mistakes to other people, but to me it still feels like they’ve been working together to cheat us and leave the kitchen wrong on purpose. But no, I’m not saying there’s some bigger thing beyond that. Is that an okay way to put it?
Have you been having problems with your memory?

No, I don’t think so… not in any serious way. I mean, I forget a word or where I put my glasses sometimes, but I think that’s fairly normal, isn’t it?

I haven’t noticed anything that feels like a real memory problem. My husband hasn’t said I’m forgetting important things, at least not that I can think of. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Have you had any recent medical illness or infection around the time this started?

No, I don’t think so. I can’t remember having any infection or being really sick right around when it started. Maybe little everyday things, but nothing that stands out to me.

If there’s a particular kind of illness you’re asking about, I can try to think harder.
Have people told you that your speech is hard to follow or that your thoughts seem jumbled?

No, I don’t think so. I mean, I try to explain myself clearly, and maybe when I’m upset I can go on a bit or repeat myself, but I haven’t had people tell me I’m not making sense.

If I’m doing that now, please tell me—I don’t want to sound confusing.
Have the people close to you said that your personality has changed?

Not really, no. I mean… I suppose my family might say I’ve been a bit more stressed or preoccupied at times, but I don’t think anyone has said my whole personality has changed.

I try to be the same person I’ve always been. If they meant something specific, maybe I’d have to ask them, but I haven’t been told that directly.
Do you believe the contractor or your neighbors have powers or abilities that ordinary people could not really have?

No, I wouldn’t say they have powers or anything like that. I know that would sound… a little strange. It’s not that.

It’s more that I’m sure the contractor and some of the people on my block are working together somehow—quietly, you know—to cheat us and keep the kitchen half-wrong on purpose. My husband keeps showing me receipts and they all have explanations, but after nearly two years of this, I just don’t believe it’s all innocent.

I hope that makes sense. I’m not saying they’re supernatural or anything.
Have you ever felt that other people could read your thoughts?

No, I don’t think so. I’ve never felt like people could actually read my thoughts.

Sometimes I worry people are noticing things or talking about things, but not that they can hear what I’m thinking. I know that would be a different kind of thing. Does that answer it okay?
